problems: Police regions are matched to geoBoundaries ADM1 only where the police region covers the same area as the administrative region (Zanzibar names mapped: Kaskazini Pemba=North Pemba, Kaskazini Unguja=Zanzibar North, Kusini Pemba=South Pemba, Kusini Unguja=Zanzibar South & Central, Mjini Magharibi=Zanzibar Urban/West). The murder tables also give suspects and causes of murder (cattle theft, robbers, superstitious beliefs, fighting, domestic disputes, jealousy, revenge, manslaughter, etc.) by region; those columns have rotated headers that pdftotext does not place reliably, so only cases and murdered persons (total, male, female) were extracted. Older reports (before 2024) are not listed on the NBS crime statistics page.
